programs.desc: A frantic husband attempts to rush his pregnant wife to the hospital when she suddenly goes into labor. The baby, however, has other plans and decides to make its grand entrance on the side of a busy highway. In a high-speed pursuit of an armed suspect, the situation takes an unexpected turn when the suspect pulls over to indulge in a joint. The perplexed officers are left with no choice but to let him enjoy his spliff.
